inputFields.name: matchIds

inputFields.name: leagueId
inputFields.description: A league id to include in this query, excluding all results that do not have this league id.

inputFields.name: leagueIds
inputFields.description: A league id to include in this query, excluding all results that do not have this league id.

inputFields.name: seriesId

inputFields.name: teamIdSteamAccount
inputFields.description: When requesting matches with a primary SteamAccountId, this will ensure that player is on specific team Id being sent in.

inputFields.name: isParsed
inputFields.description: Whether STRATZ has yet parsed the data of the match or not, represented in a boolean.

inputFields.name: startDateTime
inputFields.description: The start DateTime of the Dota match(es) to include in this query, represented in unix seconds.

inputFields.name: endDateTime
inputFields.description: The end DateTime of the Dota match(es) to include in this query, represented in unix seconds.

inputFields.name: gameModeIds
inputFields.description: An array of game mode ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these game modes.

inputFields.name: lobbyTypeIds
inputFields.description: An array of lobby type ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these lobby types.

inputFields.name: gameVersionIds
inputFields.description: An array of game version ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these game versions.

inputFields.name: regionIds
inputFields.description: An array of region ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these regions.

inputFields.name: rankIds
inputFields.description: An array of rank ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these ranks. The value ranges from 0-80 with 0 being unknown MMR and 1-80 is low to high MMR brackets. Example: 74 is Divine with 4 Stars.

inputFields.name: bracketIds
inputFields.description: An array of rank ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these ranks. The value ranges from 0-8 with 0 being unknown MMR and 1-8 is low to high MMR brackets. Example 7 is Divine.

inputFields.name: isStats
inputFields.description: STRATZ applys an formula to determine if a game is considered 'real'. We attempt to detect AFKers, leavers, feeders, etc. 'IsStats' will return matches that do not include any of these poor quality matches.

inputFields.name: heroIds
inputFields.description: An array of hero ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these heroes.

inputFields.name: laneIds
inputFields.description: An array of lane ids (enum MatchLaneType) to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these lanes. Roaming = 0, SafeLane = 1, Midlane = 2, Offlane = 3, Jungle = 4

inputFields.name: roleIds
inputFields.description: An array of role ids (enum MatchPlayerRoleType) to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these roles. Core = 0, Light Support = 1, Hard Support = 2

inputFields.name: positionIds
inputFields.description: An array of positions ids (enum MatchPlayerPositionType) to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these lanes.

inputFields.name: awardIds
inputFields.description: An array of award ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these awards. The player award types include MVP (1), Top Core (2), and Top Support (3).

inputFields.name: isParty
inputFields.description: Include all matches that are party games, excluding all others.

inputFields.name: hasAward
inputFields.description: STRATZ gives 3 players in each game an award for playing well. MVP, Top Core, Top Support (enum MatchPlayerAwardType). If you include a query of 'steamAccountId' then it will require that player to have gotten at least 1 of these awards for each match result.

inputFields.name: withFriendSteamAccountIds
inputFields.description: An array of steam account ids found on your team to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these steam accounts found on your team.

inputFields.name: withEnemySteamAccountIds
inputFields.description: A steam account id found on the enemy team to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include this steam account id found on the enemy team.

inputFields.name: withFriendHeroIds
inputFields.description: An array of hero ids found on your team to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these heroes found on your team.

inputFields.name: withEnemyHeroIds
inputFields.description: An array of hero ids found against your team to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these heroes found against team.

inputFields.name: isVictory
inputFields.description: Whether the match was a victory or not for the specified player.

inputFields.name: isRadiant
inputFields.description: Whether the specified player was on Radiant or not.

inputFields.name: minGameVersionId
inputFields.description: Requests matches where the match is at least than this input.  See GameVersion API call for a list of patch ids. Default is null and there is no minimum.

inputFields.name: maxGameVersionId
inputFields.description: Requests matches where the match is lower than this input.  See GameVersion API call for a list of patch ids. Default is null and there is no maximum.

inputFields.name: minImp
inputFields.description: Player must have at least this IMP for the Match to show.

inputFields.name: maxImp
inputFields.description: Player must have less than this IMP for the Match to show.

inputFields.name: playerList
inputFields.description: Determines if you want a single player returned, only the player by SteamAccountId, or if you want all 10 players in the match.

inputFields.name: take
inputFields.description: The amount of matches to have returned in your query. Max :

inputFields.name: skip
inputFields.description: The amount of matches to skip before collecting your query. Hint: Paging

inputFields.name: after
inputFields.description: Only return matches after this match id. Can be used instead of Skip.

inputFields.name: before
inputFields.description: Only return matches before this match id. Can be used instead of Skip.

inputFields.name: orderBy
inputFields.description: In what order the returned data will come in.
